source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册A 第五课《小马过河》
file_note: The workbook's exercises, typed. tf/order/slots/match/sort have one answer the book fixes and are marked by rule on the device. write is handwriting of a known character, judged stroke by stroke against the vendored stroke data (content/chinese/strokes). free is handwriting with no key — kept as image and strokes, judged by the chinese-review skill. speak is the retell — recorded and transcribed, with a parent's tap as the signature.

exercises.title: 左右结构，还是上下结构？

note.zh: 练习1的后半部分；写字的部分仍在纸上。
note.en: The second half of exercise 1; the handwriting stays on paper for now.

explanation.zh: 口在左、曷在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 口 on the left, 曷 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 亻在左、白在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 亻 on the left, 白 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 氵在左、罙在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 氵 on the left, 罙 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 穴在上、犬在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 穴 above, 犬 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 木在左、公在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 木 on the left, 公 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 宀在上、疋在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 宀 above, 疋 below: top–bottom.

note.zh: 看着部件，用笔把字写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: Look at the parts and write the character with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

explanation.en: 口 on the left, 曷 on the right: 喝.
亻 on the left, 白 on the right: 伯.
氵 on the left, 罙 on the right: 深.
穴 above, 犬 below: 突.
木 on the left, 公 on the right: 松.
宀 above, 疋 below: 定.

note.zh: 连好以后，写下来并组词的部分仍在纸上。
note.en: Writing the characters and forming words stays on paper for now.

explanation.en: 亻 and 白 make 伯.
氵 and 罙 make 深.

explanation.zh: 木和公合成"松"——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 木 and 公 make 松 — the book's own example.
口 and 曷 make 喝.
穴 and 犬 make 突.
宀 and 疋 make 定.

exercises.title: 找朋友：写下来并组词
exercises.title_en: Look for friends: write the characters and form words

note.zh: 连线在前面做过了；这里把六个字写下来，各组一个词。
note.en: The matching was done on the site; here write the six characters and make one word with each.

items.prompt: 伯、深、松、喝、突、定 —— 各写一遍，各组一个词（例：松 → 松鼠）
items.prompt_en: 伯 深 松 喝 突 定 — write each once and make one word with each (e.g. 松 → 松鼠)
喝: 喝茶, and three more words

note.zh: 同一个拼音，不同的字——看旁边的字想词。
note.en: Same or similar pinyin, different characters — the character beside the blank tells you the word.

explanation.en: 深浅 — shēn, deep and shallow.
身体 — shēn, body.
学生 — shēng, student.
既然 — jì, since / now that.
机会 — jī, chance.
几个 — jǐ, a few.
草原 — yuán, grassland.
公园 — yuán, park.
永远 — yuǎn, forever.
画像 — xiàng, portrait.
思想 — xiǎng, thought.
家乡 — xiāng, hometown.

exercises.title: 火车赛跑，组词语
exercises.title_en: Form words on the running trains

note.zh: 两个字长得像，各组一个词。
note.en: The two look alike; make one word with each.

exercises.title: 词语连线，并填入句子里面
exercises.title_en: Match to make words and fill in the sentences

explanation.en: 突 + 然 = 突然, suddenly.
最 + 好 = 最好, had best.
只 + 好 = 只好, had no choice but.
那 + 么 = 那么, so / that.
一 + 定 = 一定, certainly.

items.text: 他______出现在我面前，让我很惊喜。

explanation.zh: "突然"：一下子出现，所以我很惊喜。
explanation.en: 突然 — suddenly: he appeared all at once, which is why I was surprised.

items.text: 他想不出别的办法，______请人帮忙。

explanation.zh: 想不出别的办法，只好请人帮忙。
explanation.en: No other way, so he had to ask for help — 只好.

items.text: 他跑得______快，我都追不上他。

explanation.en: 那么快 — that fast.
一定要来 — you must come.

given.en: Sentence (2) is filled in by the book: 最好.

exercises.title_en: Follow the example to make sentences

items.prompt_en: Example: 鞋子是大还是小，要试穿一下才知道。 (1) …是…还是…，…。

exercises.title: 读一读

note.zh: 读出来，录下来就行，不打分。对照在批改的时候看。
note.en: Just read it aloud; it is recorded, not scored. The comparison is for the evaluation.

exercises.text:
喝水 喝茶 喝牛奶 喝汽水 喝咖啡
正在 正想 正好 正在写 正在做
河水很深。河水很浅。河水是深还是浅？
河水既不像老牛说的那样浅，也不像松鼠说的那样深。

exercises.title: 连词成句
exercises.title_en: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：老牛一定会觉得河水很浅。
explanation.en: In order: 老牛一定会觉得河水很浅 — the ox would surely think the river is shallow.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：我一定会努力学习中文。
explanation.en: In order: 我一定会努力学习中文 — I will surely study Chinese hard.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：亮亮一定会帮妈妈做家务。
explanation.en: In order: 亮亮一定会帮妈妈做家务 — Liangliang will surely help Mother with the housework.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：妹妹一定会喜欢爸爸买的玩具。
explanation.en: In order: 妹妹一定会喜欢爸爸买的玩具 — Little sister will surely like the toy Father bought.

exercises.title: 根据课文判断正误
exercises.title_en: Decide whether the statements are true or false according to the text

explanation.zh: 课文第一句就是：小马要过河。
explanation.en: The first line of the text: 小马要过河 — the pony wants to cross the river.

items.text: 老牛说水很浅，因为他又高又大。

explanation.zh: 老牛说"水很浅"；妈妈解释了原因：老牛又高又大，他会觉得水很浅。
explanation.en: The ox says the water is shallow, and Mother explains why: the ox is tall and big, so to him it feels shallow.

items.text: 小松鼠也认为很容易过河。

explanation.zh: 小松鼠说的正相反：别过河！水深得很，你会淹死的。
explanation.en: The squirrel says the opposite: don't cross — the water is very deep, you will drown.

items.text: 小马没有回家问妈妈的建议。

explanation.zh: 小马不知道该怎么办，只好回家问妈妈。
explanation.en: The pony did not know what to do, so he went home and asked his mother.

explanation.zh: 小马又跑到河边，小心地过了河。
explanation.en: The pony went back to the river and crossed it carefully.

exercises.title: 根据课文和图片给句子排序
exercises.title_en: Sequence the sentences according to the text and the pictures

note.zh: 图在练习册第37页；句子按故事先后排。
note.en: The pictures are on workbook p.37; put the sentences in the story's order.

pieces: 小松鼠从树上跳下来，告诉小马水很深，他会淹死的。
小马跑回家问妈妈，妈妈告诉他最好自己试一试。
小马又跑到河边，小心地过了河。
小马想要过河，牛伯伯告诉他水很浅，过得去。

explanation.zh: 故事的顺序：先问牛伯伯（①），松鼠跳下来（②），回家问妈妈（③），最后小心地过了河（④）。
explanation.en: The story's order: ask the ox first (①), the squirrel jumps down (②), home to ask Mother (③), then across the river carefully (④).

exercises.title: 根据课文回答问题
exercises.title_en: Answer the questions according to the text

items.prompt_en: (1) What does the pony want to do?

items.prompt: （2）牛伯伯为什么告诉小马水很浅，可以过河？
items.prompt_en: (2) Why does the ox tell the pony the water is shallow and he can cross?

items.prompt: （3）松鼠为什么说水深得很，小马会淹死的？
items.prompt_en: (3) Why does the squirrel say the water is very deep and the pony would drown?
(4) What does Mother think the pony should do?

exercises.title: 选择相应的句子补全对话
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct sentences to complete the dialogue
options: 河水是深还是浅，最好你自己去试试。
小马，别过河！水深得很呢！你会淹死的！

items.before: 小马：牛伯伯，我要过河，水深吗？

explanation.zh: 老牛说的是：水很浅，你过得去。
explanation.en: The ox's line: 水很浅，你过得去 — the water is shallow, you can get across.

explanation.zh: 小松鼠说的是：小马，别过河！水深得很呢！你会淹死的！
explanation.en: The squirrel's line: don't cross — the water is very deep, you will drown!

items.before: （小马不知道怎么办，只好回家问妈妈。）

explanation.zh: 妈妈说的是：河水是深还是浅，最好你自己去试试。
explanation.en: Mother's line: is the river deep or shallow — best go and try for yourself.

exercises.title: 把故事讲给爸爸妈妈听，考考他们
exercises.title_en: Tell the story to your parents and test them

question.zh: 《小马过河》告诉了我们什么道理？
question.en: What does 小马过河 teach us?

note.zh: 把故事讲一遍，录下来；讲完问爸爸妈妈这个问题，再请他们点一下"家长已听"。
note.en: Tell the story and it is recorded; then ask your parents the question, and have them tap Listened.
